summary: Tested Google Images integration via SerpAPI for fast recipe image loading. Backend API tests passed (12/13), with only a timing test failing due to network latency (2.76s vs expected <2s). Frontend code review confirms correct implementation of fast image loading with Google Images and AI fallback badges.

minor.issue: Response time occasionally exceeds 2 seconds due to SerpAPI network latency (2.76s observed)
